# Detail Bug Report

https://app.detail.dev/org_d38a878f-9df9-4c4b-a96a-f5180b860085/bugs/bug_1404c07b-227f-4045-bd86-d7f9a00da027

Introduced in [#99](https://github.com/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/pull/99) by @LineIndent on Jul 4, 2026

# Summary
- **Context**: `components/ui/input_group.py` provides the `input_group` namespace (`root`, `addon`, `text`, `input`, `textarea`, `button`) for building composed inputs. Every `CoreComponent` in the library shares a documented-by-tests contract for the `unstyled` escape hatch, implemented in `CoreComponent.set_class_name` in `components/ui/core.py`.
- **Bug**: `InputGroupInput`, `InputGroupTextarea`, and `InputGroupButton` bypass `set_class_name` and pre-bake their default classes into `props["class_name"]` via `cn()` before delegating to `input()`/`textarea()`/`button()`, so `unstyled=True` cannot remove the group control styles.
- **Actual vs. expected**: Expected (per the library-wide contract asserted in `tests/test_input.py` and `tests/test_collapsible.py`): `unstyled=True` keeps only the caller's `class_name`. Actual: the group control classes (`CONTROL_INPUT` / `CONTROL_TEXTAREA`) and, for `input_group.button`, the wrapper classes plus all of Button's default/variant classes, always survive.
- **Impact**: The `unstyled` escape hatch is silently broken for all three input_group controls; a caller passing `unstyled=True` gets a half-unstyled component with no error or warning, and must fight the baked-in utilities through twMerge overrides rather than starting clean (e.g. overriding `focus-visible:ring-0` with `focus-visible:ring-3`, `disabled:bg-transparent` with `disabled:bg-input`, or adding `rounded-lg border bg-white`).

# Code with Bug

`components/ui/input_group.py` — `InputGroupInput`:

```python
class InputGroupInput(CoreComponent):
    @classmethod
    def create(cls, *children, **props):
        props.setdefault("type", "text")
        props["data_slot"] = "input-group-control"
        props["class_name"] = cn(
            ClassNames.CONTROL_INPUT,
            props.get("class_name", ""),
        )  # <-- BUG 🔴 defaults pre-baked into class_name; unstyled never consulted

        return input(*children, **props)
```

`components/ui/input_group.py` — `InputGroupTextarea`:

```python
        props["class_name"] = cn(
            ClassNames.CONTROL_TEXTAREA,
            props.get("class_name", ""),
        )  # <-- BUG 🔴 same pre-baking, bypasses set_class_name
```

`components/ui/input_group.py` — `InputGroupButton`:

```python
        props["class_name"] = cn(
            "flex items-center gap-2 text-sm shadow-none",
            ClassNames.get_button_size(size),
            props.get("class_name", ""),
        )  # <-- BUG 🔴 wrapper + size classes pre-baked; button() also ignores unstyled
```

Contract being bypassed (`components/ui/core.py`):

```python
        props_class_name = props.get("class_name", "")
        unstyled = props.pop("unstyled", None)

        if unstyled is True:
            props["class_name"] = props_class_name
            return
```

# Explanation
- `CoreComponent.set_class_name(default_class_name, props)` is the library-wide mechanism that enforces the `unstyled=True` contract by ensuring only the caller’s `class_name` survives when unstyled.
- The three `input_group` controls manually merge default classes into `props["class_name"]` *before* any `set_class_name` check, so even when `unstyled=True` is passed, the wrapper defaults are already in the caller-visible `class_name` string.
- Resulting behavior is inconsistent: `input_group.root` fully honors `unstyled=True`, while `input_group.input`/`textarea` keep `CONTROL_*` classes and `input_group.button` keeps wrapper classes plus Button defaults/variant classes (since `components/ui/button.py` also doesn’t honor `unstyled`).

## Codebase Inconsistency
`components/ui/input_group.py` sibling wrappers use the correct pattern:

```python
class InputGroupText(ElSpan, CoreComponent):
    @classmethod
    def create(cls, *children, **props) -> ElSpan:
        cls.set_class_name(ClassNames.TEXT, props)
        return super().create(*children, **props)
```

# Recommended Fix
- In `components/ui/input_group.py`, route the control defaults through `cls.set_class_name(...)` (instead of pre-baking via `cn()`), while still forwarding `unstyled` to the inner `input()`/`textarea()` so their own defaults are dropped.
- Teach `Button.create` in `components/ui/button.py` to honor `unstyled` (it currently merges default/variant/size classes without consulting the prop), otherwise `input_group.button` can’t be fully unstyled.

# History
This bug was introduced in commit 755f3ede ("v0.9.1 release (#99)"). The v0.9.1 "API Consolidation" rewrite implemented the three control wrappers by pre-baking defaults into `props["class_name"]` instead of using `cls.set_class_name(...)`, breaking the `unstyled` contract. Verified via `git blame` / `git log -S "CONTROL_INPUT"` / `git log --follow` (later commits touching the file did not change these lines).

"""Tests for the Collapsible panel's class_name shield.

``CollapsiblePanel`` carries the structural ``transition-[height]`` animation
on ``ClassNames.PANEL``. Because ``cn()`` resolves via tailwind-merge
(client-side), any user-supplied ``transition-*`` utility merged onto the *same*
element drops ``transition-[height]`` (same twMerge conflict group, last-wins).

``AccordionPanel`` was hardened in 755f3ed by popping the user's ``class_name``
off the panel props and routing it to an inner content wrapper, so the panel
element always retains its structural transition. These tests verify
``CollapsiblePanel`` adopts the same shield and that the escape hatches
(``unstyled``, ``render_``) keep working through the new code path.

``cn()`` returns a deferred reflex ``Var`` (a serialized JS call template), so
its ``str()`` form embeds both literal inputs — see ``tests/test_context_menu.py``
for the established assertion convention.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, cast

from reflex.components.component import Component

def test_panel_keeps_height_transition_for_transition_star_utilities() -> None:
    """Regression for the height-animation bug: any ``transition-*`` utility passed
    via ``class_name`` shares tailwind-merge's transition-property conflict group
    with the structural ``transition-[height]`` and would drop it if merged onto
    the panel element. The panel must keep ``transition-[height]`` and route the
    user utility to the inner wrapper.
    """
    for user_class in (
        "transition-all",
        "transition-opacity",
        "transition-colors",
        "transition-transform",
        "transition",
        "transition-[background-color]",
        "transition-[opacity] duration-500",
    ):
        panel = _panel(class_name=user_class)
        # Panel element is always exactly cn(PANEL, "") — transition-[height] survives.
        assert str(panel.class_name) == _shielded_panel_class_name(), (
            f"panel element changed for user class {user_class!r}"

"""Regression tests for the ``input_group`` controls' ``unstyled`` contract.

``InputGroupInput``, ``InputGroupTextarea``, and ``InputGroupButton`` used to
pre-bake their default classes into ``props["class_name"]`` via ``cn()``
*before* delegating to ``input()``/``textarea()``/``button()``, so
``CoreComponent.set_class_name``'s ``unstyled=True`` branch (``core.py``) was
unreachable for them: the wrapper classes were already merged into what the
inner component treated as "the caller's class_name". ``input_group.root``,
``.addon``, and ``.text`` already routed through ``set_class_name`` correctly
(see https://github.com/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/issues/167).

The fix routes the wrapper-level defaults through ``cls.set_class_name(...)``
and re-forwards ``unstyled`` into the inner ``input()``/``textarea()``/
``button()`` call so each layer independently honors the escape hatch.

Note: ``Button.create`` (``components/ui/button.py``) does not itself
consult ``unstyled`` when merging its own default/variant/size classes -
that is a separate, pre-existing bug in ``button.py`` and is out of scope
here. The button tests below only assert that the ``input_group.button``
*wrapper* classes honor ``unstyled``.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT_DIR))

import reflex as rx  # noqa: E402

from components.ui.input import ClassNames as InputClassNames  # noqa: E402
from components.ui.input_group import (  # noqa: E402
    ClassNames,
    InputGroupButton,
    InputGroupInput,
    InputGroupTextarea,
)
from components.ui.textarea import ClassNames as TextareaClassNames  # noqa: E402


class _UnstyledState(rx.State):  # pyright: ignore[reportUntypedBaseClass]
    """State exposing a boolean Var for the dynamic ``unstyled`` escape hatch."""

    flag: bool = False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# InputGroupInput
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_input_group_input_uses_default_classes() -> None:
    control = InputGroupInput.create()
    class_name = str(control.class_name)

    assert ClassNames.CONTROL_INPUT in class_name
    assert InputClassNames.INPUT in class_name


def test_input_group_input_merges_custom_class_name() -> None:
    control = InputGroupInput.create(class_name="custom-input")
    class_name = str(control.class_name)

    assert ClassNames.CONTROL_INPUT in class_name
    assert InputClassNames.INPUT in class_name
    assert "custom-input" in class_name


def test_input_group_input_unstyled_keeps_only_custom_class() -> None:
    control = InputGroupInput.create(class_name="custom-input", unstyled=True)

    assert str(control.class_name) == "custom-input"


def test_input_group_input_unstyled_without_custom_class_is_empty() -> None:
    control = InputGroupInput.create(unstyled=True)

    assert str(control.class_name) == ""


def test_input_group_input_unstyled_not_rendered_to_dom() -> None:
    control = InputGroupInput.create(class_name="custom-input", unstyled=True)
    rendered_props = " ".join(control.render()["props"])

    assert "unstyled" not in rendered_props


def test_input_group_input_var_unstyled_toggles_classes_dynamically() -> None:
    control = InputGroupInput.create(
        class_name="custom-input",
        unstyled=_UnstyledState.flag,
    )
    class_name = str(control.class_name)

    # The class_name is gated on the Var via a ternary (rx.cond), not stripped.
    assert "?" in class_name
    assert "custom-input" in class_name
    assert ClassNames.CONTROL_INPUT in class_name
    assert InputClassNames.INPUT in class_name


def test_input_group_input_defaults_type_and_data_slot() -> None:
    control = InputGroupInput.create()
    rendered_props = " ".join(control.render()["props"])

    assert '"type":"text"' in rendered_props
    assert '"data-slot":"input-group-control"' in rendered_props


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# InputGroupTextarea
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_input_group_textarea_uses_default_classes() -> None:
    control = InputGroupTextarea.create()
    class_name = str(control.class_name)

    assert ClassNames.CONTROL_TEXTAREA in class_name
    assert TextareaClassNames.ROOT in class_name


def test_input_group_textarea_merges_custom_class_name() -> None:
    control = InputGroupTextarea.create(class_name="custom-textarea")
    class_name = str(control.class_name)

    assert ClassNames.CONTROL_TEXTAREA in class_name
    assert TextareaClassNames.ROOT in class_name
    assert "custom-textarea" in class_name


def test_input_group_textarea_unstyled_keeps_only_custom_class() -> None:
    control = InputGroupTextarea.create(class_name="custom-textarea", unstyled=True)

    assert str(control.class_name) == "custom-textarea"


def test_input_group_textarea_unstyled_without_custom_class_is_empty() -> None:
    control = InputGroupTextarea.create(unstyled=True)

    assert str(control.class_name) == ""


def test_input_group_textarea_unstyled_not_rendered_to_dom() -> None:
    control = InputGroupTextarea.create(class_name="custom-textarea", unstyled=True)
    rendered_props = " ".join(control.render()["props"])

    assert "unstyled" not in rendered_props


def test_input_group_textarea_defaults_data_slot() -> None:
    control = InputGroupTextarea.create()
    rendered_props = " ".join(control.render()["props"])

    assert '"data-slot":"input-group-control"' in rendered_props


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# InputGroupButton
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_WRAPPER_MARKER = "shadow-none"
_SIZE_XS_MARKER = "rounded-[calc(var(--radius)-3px)]"
_BUTTON_DEFAULT_MARKER = "group/button"


def test_input_group_button_uses_default_classes() -> None:
    control = InputGroupButton.create("Send")
    class_name = str(control.class_name)

    assert _WRAPPER_MARKER in class_name
    assert _SIZE_XS_MARKER in class_name
    # Button's own defaults (components/ui/button.py) still merge in; the
    # input_group wrapper is not responsible for those.
    assert _BUTTON_DEFAULT_MARKER in class_name


def test_input_group_button_merges_custom_class_name() -> None:
    control = InputGroupButton.create("Send", class_name="custom-btn")
    class_name = str(control.class_name)

    assert _WRAPPER_MARKER in class_name
    assert "custom-btn" in class_name


def test_input_group_button_unstyled_omits_wrapper_defaults() -> None:
    """The wrapper-level defaults (this file's bug) honor ``unstyled``.

    ``Button.create`` itself does not yet consult ``unstyled`` when merging
    its own ``DEFAULT_CLASS_NAME``/variant/size classes (``components/ui/
    button.py``) - that is a separate, pre-existing bug and out of scope for
    this fix, so ``_BUTTON_DEFAULT_MARKER`` is still expected here.
    """
    control = InputGroupButton.create("Send", class_name="custom-btn", unstyled=True)
    class_name = str(control.class_name)

    assert "custom-btn" in class_name
    assert _WRAPPER_MARKER not in class_name
    assert _SIZE_XS_MARKER not in class_name
    assert _BUTTON_DEFAULT_MARKER in class_name


def test_input_group_button_unstyled_not_rendered_to_dom() -> None:
    control = InputGroupButton.create("Send", class_name="custom-btn", unstyled=True)
    rendered_props = " ".join(control.render()["props"])

    assert "unstyled" not in rendered_props


def test_input_group_button_defaults_type_variant_and_size() -> None:
    control = InputGroupButton.create("Send")
    rendered_props = " ".join(control.render()["props"])

    assert '"type":"button"' in rendered_props
    assert '"data-size":"xs"' in rendered_props


def test_input_group_button_preserves_explicit_size() -> None:
    control = InputGroupButton.create("Send", size="icon-sm")
    class_name = str(control.class_name)
    rendered_props = " ".join(control.render()["props"])

    assert '"data-size":"icon-sm"' in rendered_props
    assert "size-8" in class_name

Opened PR #267: https://github.com/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/pull/267

Summary of the fix:
- `InputGroupInput`, `InputGroupTextarea`, and `InputGroupButton` in `components/ui/input_group.py` now route their default classes through `cls.set_class_name(...)` (instead of pre-baking via `cn()`) and forward `unstyled` into the inner `input()`/`textarea()`/`button()` call, so each layer independently honors `unstyled=True`.
- Added `tests/test_input_group.py` (19 tests) covering defaults, custom-class merging, static and `Var[bool]` `unstyled`, and DOM-leak checks.
- Regenerated `assets/docs/components/input-group.md` since it's a generated snippet mirroring the source file and a test enforces that sync.

One caveat called out in the PR: `input_group.button` can't be *fully* unstyled yet because `Button.create` in `components/ui/button.py` has its own separate, pre-existing bug (it never checks `unstyled` when merging its default/variant/size classes). That's out of scope per your instructions to stay strictly within `input_group.py` and its tests, so I left it alone and documented it clearly in both the test file and PR description rather than silently papering over it.
